notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: config.json nested 'lfm' backbone (LFM2-1.2B): 16 layers, only 6 'full_attention' (the 10 conv layers keep a fixed conv_L_cache-3 state, not per-token KV): 6 x 8 kv_heads x 64 head_dim x 2 (K,V) x 2 B bf16 = 12,288 B/token. head_dim 64 = hidden 2048 / 32 heads. FastConformer encoder and 6-layer depthformer are forward passes, not KV. ctx 32,768 is the served window the card documents; config max_position_embeddings is 128,000, inherited from the text backbone. REVIEWED 2026-10-21: card confirms every claimed row. Card publishes VoiceBench and ASR tables; all 5 record rows match LFM2.5-Audio-1.5B row. RELEASE DATE CORRECTED 2026-10-21: was 2026, now 2025 per the HF repo creation date (2025-12-18). The wrong year made every recency multiplier a no-op for this record.
